item.title: InfraBench Benchmark Exposes Infrastructure Agents Failing at Durable, Safe Operations
item.summary: InfraBench, a new open benchmark from University of Wisconsin–Madison and Iowa State University researchers, evaluates AI infrastructure agents across the full system stack and operational lifecycle, finding that even the best configurations score only 40%–88% and routinely leave non-durable changes, broken invariants, and unsafe side effects behind.
